source_summary: Vertical ink-and-wash Chinese landscape with towering craggy mountains, dotted foliage, a large foreground pine, bamboo and shrubs, misty open ground, and a lone scholar with a walking staff. Calligraphy and seals in the upper right are excluded.

motifs.name: central_towering_crags
motifs.description: The main cluster of steep, vertically striated mountain peaks rising through the upper center, including multiple narrow summits and connected cliff faces with dark dotted foliage clinging to ridges and ledges.
must_preserve: long vertical ink strokes and pale wash modeling on cliff faces
irregular peak silhouettes
dense dark ink-dot foliage along ridgelines and crevices
layered overlapping crag forms
soft fading lower edges where the mountains dissolve into mist

motifs.name: left_framing_cliff
motifs.description: Tall cropped cliff wall along the left edge, with a narrow vertical rock face, sparse dark foliage dots, and lower rocky buttresses framing the scene.
must_preserve: cropped edge composition
thin wavering contour lines
vertical rock texture strokes
small clustered dark foliage dots along cracks and ledges
pale ink wash transitions on the cliff face

motifs.name: right_rounded_rocky_hill
motifs.description: Rounded rocky hill mass on the mid-right, partly cropped at the edge, with arched hollows, sloping shoulders, and dotted shrubs across the top and seams.
must_preserve: rounded hill silhouette
arched dark hollow near the center
short vertical rock texture strokes
dark foliage dots scattered over crown and crevices
soft grey-brown wash on stone surfaces

motifs.name: large_foreground_pine
motifs.description: Large twisting pine tree occupying the lower center-right, with two textured trunks, sweeping horizontal branches, and dense fan-like needle clusters spreading across the foreground.
must_preserve: forked twisting trunks with bark stipple texture
arching branch structure
individual radiating pine-needle clusters
dark ink outlines and fine twig linework
asymmetrical canopy spreading left and right

motifs.name: lower_left_broadleaf_tree
motifs.description: Low broadleaf tree and shrub mass in the lower-left foreground, with angular branching and many small pointed leaf clusters beneath the mountain opening.
must_preserve: angular branching pattern
small repeated leaf strokes
dark ink leaf clusters with lighter interior gaps
low spreading silhouette
connection to the foreground slope without including the scholar

motifs.name: right_bamboo_grove
motifs.description: Slender bamboo grove behind the pine on the lower right, with upright culms, fine leaves, and a small rock base at the edge of the path.
must_preserve: thin vertical bamboo stalks
delicate paired leaf strokes
layered foliage density
small base rocks and dark root-side accents
separation from the pine trunk in front

motifs.name: lone_scholar_with_staff
motifs.description: Small robed scholar standing on the open path near the bottom center, holding a tall walking staff, with simple facial features and flowing robe lines.
must_preserve: upright walking staff
fine robe contour lines and sleeve folds
small head, hair, and facial marks
visible feet beneath robe
quiet standing pose facing slightly left

motifs.name: misty_valley_opening
motifs.description: Pale mist-filled open space between the central mountains and foreground trees, including faint ground line and soft atmospheric wash that separates background cliffs from the lower path.
must_preserve: soft blank wash area
faded mountain bases dissolving into mist
subtle horizontal ground or path line
gentle tonal transition between cliff and foreground
empty breathing space characteristic of the composition

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
